headline: Brainbees Solutions Limited: Monitoring Agency Report (Q1 FY27)
sum: FirstCry's Monitoring Agency submitted its Q1 FY27 report to NSE on utilization of IPO proceeds, confirming deployment of capital raised through the public equity issuance into project heads per prospectus.
implication: The filing evidences ongoing post-IPO compliance with SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018 on fund utilization tracking; materiality turns on whether deployment is tracking prospectus allocations and whether any variance triggers remedial disclosure.
detail: Brainbees Solutions Limited, trading as FirstCry, completed its public equity issuance and submitted a Monitoring Agency Report to NSE for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The report documents the utilization of IPO proceeds across designated project heads per the prospectus. This quarterly submission is mandatory under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018, Regulation 32(1), requiring listed issuers to report utilization of funds raised through public issues within 30 days of each quarter-end or balance-sheet date. The filing was received by NSE's Disclosure Monitoring Agency on 13 August 2026.
